correctness.rationale: One exponential uniform-angle leg has Fourier transform β/sqrt(β²+|ξ|²), giving Gamma(n/2,β²/2) mixing of centered planar Gaussians for K=n. For m>n, f_m(r)/f_n(r) is proportional to E[V^((m−n)/2)] under a Gamma-exponential-tilted measure whose RN derivative between r2>r1 is exp(−(r2²−r1²)/(2V)), strictly increasing in V; this proves posterior MLR. The marked characteristic function pzβ/(sqrt(β²+|ξ|²)−qzβ) separates a positive K0(κ(z)r) pole and a remainder decaying e^(−βr)/r² versus main e^(−βsqrt(1−q²z²)r)/sqrt(r). Analytic uniform Bessel asymptotics give cumulants and CLT. Independently integrated the Gamma mixture against Bessel densities for 30 positive parameter triples, tested strict MLR pairs, and confirmed constants at three large radii. These finite tests do not establish global inequalities.

value.rationale: Posterior inference from final displacement is a natural inverse problem in killed random motion, complementary to forward Bessel-distribution formulas. Strict distribution-wide likelihood-ratio ordering is stronger than a mean trend, while explicit Gaussian scaling and order-one mean/variance corrections provide sharp geometric stopping-index inference.

final_claim: For a geometric-index-killed isotropic planar Poisson random flight, K|R=r is strictly increasing in r in pairwise monotone-likelihood-ratio order; as r→∞ it has a conditional Gaussian limit with mean a r+2+q²/(2s²)+O(1/r), variance b r+q²/s⁴+O(1/r), a=βq²/s, b=βq²(2−q²)/s³, s²=1−q².
